title: Caddy
description: Web server that obtains and renews HTTPS certificates on its own.

fields.name: caddyfile
fields.label: Caddyfile
fields.help: Your Caddyfile on this host, inside allowed_paths.

fields.name: http_port
fields.label: HTTP port
fields.help: Must be reachable from the internet for certificate issuance to work.

fields.name: data_volume
fields.label: Certificate volume
fields.help: Keep this. Losing it means re-issuing every certificate, and issuers rate-limit that.

notes: Caddy needs ports 80 and 443 reachable from the internet to issue certificates. The certificates live in the data volume — keep it across redeploys or you will hit the issuer's rate limit.
